texts: Why did Old Vesh report the thin feather autumn of twenty-six years ago to the Council in Year 1?

fields.sentence: Why did Old Vesh report the thin feather autumn of twenty-six years ago to the Council in Year 1?
parse: (: $prf (And (Name $v "Old Vesh") (Member $e report) (Agent $e $v) (Theme $e $a) (Member $a feather_autumn) (Member $a thin) (BeforeBy $a now 26 year) (Recipient $e $c) (Member $c council) (Time $e (Year 1)) (Past $e) (ReasonFor $r $e)) $tv)

q2_gaps: a temporal of-phrase restricting a noun ("the thin feather autumn OF twenty-six years ago") - the of-phrase rules cover only possessive/relational, nominalization-object, partitive, measure and about- readings, and none of them is a time-locating of-phrase inside an NP
review.notes: The unaddressed temporal of-phrase is rendered by composing two licensed rules - 'N units ago' anchoring on the reserved symbol now, and time/ordering atoms attaching to an event-denoting noun - giving (BeforeBy $a now 26 year), which is a defensible reading rather than a defect. 'report' with an entity object correctly keeps Agent/Theme (not the sealed-complement Experiencer), 'to the Council' is Recipient as an addressee of communication, and 'Old Vesh' binds by its verbatim capitalized-run Name string.
